description: Welcome to SpaceCloud!  We are a dedicated creative team focused on bridging the gap between raw space science and public education. For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are translating complex planetary tracking archives into a dreamy accessible digital storybook tailored specifically for school-aged children and visually impaired readers. Led by our original animated droid mascot, STAR. This team is a solo track ran by a 12 year old, we will ensure this project will make a child inspired.
summary: Our team developed The Cosmic Adventure, an interactive digital story e-flipbook about abandoned equipment on Mars and the Moon. To address the challenge, our droid mascot STAR introduces children to NASA's Moon retroreflectors and Mars rovers (Opportunity, Spirit, Curiosity, and Perseverance) using warm illustrations and custom audio buttons. This project is important because it transforms complex space mission history into an engaging, accessible educational experience that inspires both curious young readers and visually impaired children to explore space science.
details: The Cosmic Adventure is an interactive digital flipbook where droid mascot STAR guides children through NASA's Moon retroreflectors and Mars rovers using audio narration. It simplifies complex space mission history into bite-sized two text box stories with custom voiceovers, making space science accessible for both young readers and visually impaired kids. We aim to spark curiosity in young learners and give blind or visually impaired children an inclusive, joyful way to explore NASA's Moon and Mars heritage independently or with care. Developed on a Windows 10 PC and tablet using ibisPaint X for hand-drawn art, fish.audio for character voiceovers, Heyzine for the interactive e-flipbook, and Alight Motion for video editing. Instead of text-heavy slides, we invented an original 1,100-foot droid mascot, STAR, paired with dreamy outline-free art, and interactive audio buttons. We considered children's short attention spans by limiting pages to two text box, ensured high-contrast text readability, and added full audio narration for visually impaired accessibility.
